percentCard.title: The “3% of sales” model
percentCard.description: Pay only when you earn: 3% of every sale, no fixed subscription fee. Online payments are split instantly; cash and deposits accrue and arrive as one invoice each month.

mode.alreadyActive: This payment model is already active — below you can renew or change the plan
mode.confirmSwitchMessage: Your subscription is active. Switching models takes effect immediately and the remainder of the paid period IS FORFEITED entirely: the unused days are not refunded and do not carry over.
mode.termsMessage:
On this plan the platform withholds {{rate}}% of every sale.

For online payments the fee is withheld automatically at the moment of payment. For cash, terminal and deposit top-ups it is NOT withheld immediately — it accrues, and you receive a separate invoice once a month.

You have {{days}} days to pay that invoice. If it is not paid in time, access to the CRM and to the client mini-app is suspended until it is settled.

The current amount due is shown in Billing; you can pay at any time, including early.
mode.termsMinimum: Minimum monthly charge is {{amount}} {{currency}}. If over a calendar month the platform earned less than that from your studio (for example, there were no sales through the CRM at all), you are invoiced for the difference. Earn more than the minimum and there is no invoice. An unpaid minimum charge suspends access the same way an unpaid commission invoice does.
mode.termsBurn: WARNING: you have a paid period left. Switching the billing model FORFEITS it entirely — the unused days are not refunded and do not carry over.
mode.termsCombo: The switch is a PURCHASE: right after you confirm, you will see the amount due. The remainder of your current paid period is forfeited — it is not refunded and does not carry over. The fixed + % model turns on ONLY after payment; until then your plan stays as it is and nothing is charged.

fields.vatHint: Businesses only. The number is checked against the EU registry (VIES) the moment you save — we don't accept unverified ones. With a valid number a company in another EU country is invoiced without tax (reverse charge). Individuals don't have one — leave it empty.
fields.vatOutsideEu: We don't ask for a VAT number: outside the EU the tax is set by the payer's country, not their number, so it makes no difference to the invoice.
fields.vatPending: Your number is saved, but the EU registry was unavailable at the time, so it is not confirmed yet and your next invoice will include full VAT. No need to re-enter it: we keep re-checking, and once the registry responds the tax stops being charged. For an invoice already paid, support will refund the tax.
